-- Phase 2: bodies filled in. Contracts and signatures are unchanged.

-- True when `path` stays inside the notes directory once its
-- `..` segments are resolved. Absolute paths and any path that
-- climbs above the root are rejected.
is_safe(path: str) -> bool =
  pre path.char_count() >= 0
  post not out or path.char_count() > 0
  ex is_safe("a.txt") == True
  ex is_safe("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex is_safe("") == False
  ex is_safe("..") == False
  ex is_safe("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex is_safe("sub/../../x") == False
  if path.char_count() == 0
    return False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  if parts[0] == ""
    return False
  var depth = 0
  for seg in parts
    if seg == "" or seg == "."
      continue
    if seg == ".."
      depth = depth - 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      depth = depth + 1
  depth > 0

-- Returns the text of `notes/path`, or "" when the path is unsafe,
-- the file is missing, or the file cannot be read. Reads only through
-- `fs`, which is narrowed to the `notes` directory.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre path.char_count() >= 0
  post out == "" or is_safe(path)
  if not is_safe(path)
    return ""
  var result = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    result = fs.read(path) else ""
  result
